title: HB 1324 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to evidence of identification for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(c)(2) (Sec. 1)
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) 2-7-112(c)(8) new (Sec. 2)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) new subsection of 2-7-112 (Sec. 3(1))
(quote) The secretary of state shall conduct a study into the use of student identification cards for the purposes of voting.
(other) Sec. 3: study lists consulting seven bodies; first report due Jan. 31, 2022; a second report assessing postsecondary IDs under (c)(8) due Jan. 31, 2023; the subsection is repealed Feb. 1, 2023.
(other) Sec. 4: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: 2288905-Draft: Draft only; adds a postsecondary-institution photo ID to 2-7-112(c) and orders a secretary of state study of student IDs for voting.
(other) note: Only the Draft is saved. The Jan. 2022 report date had passed by the last action (returned to the clerk's desk 2022-03-30). No roll call saved. Companion SB947 is not in this group.
